aitu_auth.title: AITU Account Authentication
aitu_auth.instruction.1: Link your Minecraft account with your AITU Telegram account.
aitu_auth.instruction.2: 1. Open the Telegram bot and obtain your linking token.
aitu_auth.instruction.3: 2. Paste your token below and click Link Account.
aitu_auth.token_hint: Paste token or session JSON here...
aitu_auth.error.invalid_format: Invalid token format! Please enter a valid token.
